summary: Heavily obfuscated offensive email-abuse / SMTP-cracker toolkit acting on operator-chosen targets
details: monogrok is a javascript-obfuscator-hardened CLI ('M!T') whose ~220 modules implement bulk mailers (func/snd/mlr/*), SendGrid / AWS-SES / generic SMTP credential checkers (func/smx/*), IMAP / POP3 / EWS mailbox authentication (func/box/imap.js, pop3.js, ewsv.js, caut.js), Shodan-driven SMTP infrastructure discovery (func/sho/*, func/smx/awssho.js, sgsho.js), redirect / phishing URL scanning (func/rdt/*), and SOCKS / proxy rotation with anti-detection (func/ipr/*, utils/hide.js). Bundled config assets under _init/props/.smtp reference email-smtp.*.amazonaws.com targets and a discord.com/api/webhooks result-hook. package.json declares dependencies imapflow, nodemailer, @aws-sdk/client-ses, socks-proxy-agent and defines no npm lifecycle scripts (no preinstall / install / postinstall / prepare). No code path reads installer-owned secret locations (~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, browser profiles), scrapes process.env broadly, or exfiltrates installer host data to a hardcoded author endpoint. The offensive capabilities are directed at external SMTP servers, mailboxes, and recipients the operator explicitly supplies at runtime, not at the machine that runs `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
